gloss: nape of the neck; back of the neck

definitions.gloss: nape of the neck; back of the neck
definitions.explanation: The area at the back or side of the neck, from the base of the skull down to the shoulders.

examples.english: I broke out in sweat on the back of my neck.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{首筋|くびすじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たって→当たる：01860_ataru⟧⟦{寒気|さむけ}→寒気：16081_samuke⟧がした。
examples.english: The cold wind hit the back of my neck and I felt a chill.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}め→日焼け止め：05120_hiyakedome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{首筋|くびすじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れ→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}って→塗る：01174_nuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Don't forget to apply sunscreen to the back of your neck as well.

notes:
The back and sides of the neck. Composed of ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧ (neck) + ⟦{筋|すじ}→筋：03366_suji⟧ (line, sinew) — literally the "line of the neck."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {首筋|くびすじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|ふ}れる→触れる：01984_fureru⟧: to touch the nape
- {首筋|くびすじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧: the back of the neck is cold
- {首筋|くびすじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{汗|あせ}をかく→汗をかく：16925_asewokaku⟧: to sweat on the back of the neck
- {首筋|くびすじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぞくっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to feel a shiver down the back of the neck

USAGE:
Often appears in literature and descriptions of physical sensation — cold breezes, shivers, someone's touch. The {首筋|くびすじ} is considered a sensitive and intimate area.
